method: Developer walkthrough via CUA in Codex in-app browser, loopback HTTP; native UI actions. Not a human reader trial.
scope: Four-task walkthrough, draft retention, readable history and TXT download tested. Final two next-step wording corrections followed by reload and a complete 2.5 ms window cycle; earlier full-flow evidence retained with that limit.
observed_checks: START_HERE normal record and three-question explanation rendered; experiment link opened a separate task tab.
T1 summary visible before prediction; dropdown labels name units and concrete target.
Blank predictions rejected; blank observation blocks feedback.
Chinese pre-run reason retained under old 2.5 ms condition after selecting 4 ms; visible as plain-language unfinished notes.
At 4 ms an intentionally wrong insufficient-evidence prediction receives corrective functional FAIL explanation; measurement remains INVALID.
Next-task navigation retains completed attempts and clears current form.
DC comparison names DC-removed target and disables irrelevant resistor selection; matched HVL path names corrected target and reaches VALID/PASS.
Numerical-rule task reaches VALID measurement, FAIL numerical limit and PASS T1 separately.
Challenge preview shows only 4.4 ms; longer-record control hidden until prediction, requested evidence, proposed check, explanation and feedback.
Longer 6 ms evidence adds VALID/PASS without overwriting original INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE; expanded history retains both.
TXT download physically saved: four labeled automated attempts plus one Chinese unfinished note. JSON export was not separately retested in v0.5.
Chinese trial guide renders; its static-route link opens worksheet with descriptive labels; evidence then feedback disclosures work.
Final reloaded build completes 2.5 ms INVALID/INSUFFICIENT cycle and displays corrected next-step wording.
Browser console query after four-task walkthrough returned no errors.
limitations: Direct file:// opening not tested; browser protocol restriction retained, no bypass.
Initial sandbox HTTP server timed out; restarted with approved loopback execution. Error-page data: protocol was blocked; no attempt to inspect that page by a bypass.
No fresh browser/OS, mobile or screen-reader user study. Native HTML disclosure contains no script, but no separate browser JS-disable preference was changed.
TXT download tool response was unusually delayed; do not use automation wall time as reader completion time.
Free text is not automatically graded. In-page feedback is intentionally accessible; not a secure examination.
